# ahb

## Overview

Android Hardware Buffer (AHB) draw tests that verify correct rendering to color attachments backed by Android Hardware Buffer external memory. The tests render triangle lists to AHB-backed images with varying layer counts, then compare the rendered output against a software reference renderer.

## Role

Validates that Vulkan rendering to images backed by Android Hardware Buffer external memory produces correct results. Exercises the full pipeline of AHB allocation, external memory import, image creation, rendering, and CPU-side readback validation. Tests single-layer rendering as well as multi-layer rendering where each layer is exposed as a separate color attachment with its own subpass.

## Test Families

### triangle_list — Single-layer AHB draw

Renders 9 vertices (3 triangles) as a triangle list to a single-layer AHB-backed color attachment (R8G8B8A8_UNORM, 256x256). Each subpass draws to one layer. The rendered output is compared against a software reference renderer.

Source: [vktDrawAhbTests.cpp#L631](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawAhbTests.cpp#L631)

### triangle_list_layers_3 — Three-layer AHB draw

Renders 27 vertices (3 triangles per layer) as a triangle list to a 3-layer AHB-backed color attachment. Each layer is a separate color attachment with its own subpass. The rendered output for each layer is compared against a software reference renderer.

Source: [vktDrawAhbTests.cpp#L634-L635](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawAhbTests.cpp#L634-L635)

### triangle_list_layers_5 — Five-layer AHB draw

Renders 45 vertices (3 triangles per layer) as a triangle list to a 5-layer AHB-backed color attachment. Each layer is a separate color attachment with its own subpass. The rendered output for each layer is compared against a software reference renderer.

Source: [vktDrawAhbTests.cpp#L638-L639](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawAhbTests.cpp#L638-L639)

### triangle_list_layers_8 — Eight-layer AHB draw

Renders 72 vertices (3 triangles per layer) as a triangle list to an 8-layer AHB-backed color attachment. Each layer is a separate color attachment with its own subpass. The rendered output for each layer is compared against a software reference renderer.

Source: [vktDrawAhbTests.cpp#L642-L643](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawAhbTests.cpp#L642-L643)

## Parameter Dimensions

| Dimension | Values | Description |
|-----------|--------|-------------|
| Layer count | 1, 3, 5, 8 | Number of array layers in the AHB-backed image |
| Vertex count | 9, 27, 45, 72 | Total vertices (9 per layer) |
| Image dimensions | 256x256 | Fixed render target size |
| Color format | VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM | Fixed color attachment format |

## Support / Feature Requirements

| Requirement | Condition | Details |
|-------------|-----------|---------|
| Vulkan only | `!CTS_USES_VULKANSC` | Registered under `#ifndef CTS_USES_VULKANSC` in the parent module ([vktDrawTests.cpp#L103](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawTests.cpp#L103)) |
| Renderpass only | `!useDynamicRendering` | Not added to dynamic rendering variants; uses subpasses which cannot be translated to dynamic rendering ([vktDrawTests.cpp#L106-L114](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawTests.cpp#L106-L114)) |
| AHB extension | `VK_ANDROID_external_memory_android_hardware_buffer` | Required device functionality checked in `checkSupport` ([vktDrawAhbTests.cpp#L219](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawAhbTests.cpp#L219)) |
| AHB API availability | `AndroidHardwareBufferExternalApi::getInstance()` | Platform must support AHB; throws `NotSupportedError` if unavailable ([vktDrawAhbTests.cpp#L326-L327](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawAhbTests.cpp#L326-L327)) |
| Max color attachments | `m_data.m_numLayers <= maxColorAttachments` | Each layer is a separate color attachment; throws `NotSupportedError` if device limit is insufficient ([vktDrawAhbTests.cpp#L226-L227](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawAhbTests.cpp#L226-L227)) |
| AHB layer allocation | AHB allocation success | Throws `NotSupportedError` if the platform cannot allocate an AHB with the required number of layers ([vktDrawAhbTests.cpp#L335-L336](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawAhbTests.cpp#L335-L336)) |

## Verification Methods

| Method | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| Fuzzy image comparison | Uses `tcu::fuzzyCompare` with a threshold of 0.053 to compare the rendered output against a software reference image generated by the `rr::Renderer` ([vktDrawAhbTests.cpp#L620-L622](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawAhbTests.cpp#L620-L622)) |

## Notes

- The multi-layer tests use a multi-subpass render pass where each subpass renders to one layer of the AHB image. This is why the tests are renderpass-only and cannot be translated to dynamic rendering.
- Vertex data is generated procedurally using a seeded random number generator (`SEED = 0xc2a39fu`), XORed with the layer and vertex counts for deterministic but varied data.
- The reference renderer uses a simple pass-through vertex and fragment shader pair that forwards position and color attributes without transformation.
- The test uses dedicated allocation (`VkMemoryDedicatedAllocateInfo`) for binding the AHB external memory to the Vulkan image.
